items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: It was already explained above in Answer 175 that, since there is no absence in the spiritual, all the phases that were previously in HGT are also found there, which is the secret of the inclusion of all the phases of NHY and HGT, and of Atik and AA from the time they were two Partzufim, and so on, all of which participate in the emanation of ZA. And accordingly, the ARI says that the HGT of AA are still clothed within the inner NHY of AA, even though, from another perspective, they have indeed already risen to the phase of GAR, as mentioned above. (Item 919, item 86; Item 920, item 87)
